tools.name: tts_status
tools.description: Report engine + gateway health, GPU VRAM/temp, queue depth and the currently loaded voice.

tools.name: tts_list_voices
tools.description: List configured voices with their per-voice parameters (lang, speed_factor, sample_steps, reference audio).

tools.name: tts_speak
tools.description: Synthesize text to a WAV file via the gateway; returns the file path, duration and time-to-first-byte.

speed_factor.description: Speech speed; defaults to the voice's speed_factor (0.88).

tools.name: tts_set_params
tools.description: Update synthesis defaults in services\config.json (atomic write, other fields preserved). Returns the effective values.

tools.name: tts_set_reference
tools.description: Set the reference audio path and prompt text for a voice in services\config.json.

tools.name: tts_switch_voice
tools.description: Switch the engine's loaded GPT weights (full voice) via /set_gpt_weights. Takes ~15s; do not call mid-session repeatedly.

tools.name: tts_warmup
tools.description: Send one tiny synthesis to warm the reference cache; returns elapsed time.

text.description: Defaults to audio.warmup_text or the default warmup phrase.
